required_basis: declared unit profile and original ordered cohort
source_fallback_order: matched actual accrual if available and complete
current official published tariff with temporal/method scope and user-requested interval midpoint

field_sources.return_flow: commissions.<scheme>_return_flow_amount; grouped service estimate, no blind extra handling
field_sources.extra_courier: Historical financial-day control only; not added to forecast last-mile tariff
field_sources.ads_cpo: finance.balance promotion_with_cost_per_order, crosschecked against qualified Performance data
field_sources.ads_cpc: finance.balance pay_per_click, crosschecked against qualified Performance data
field_sources.cogs: owner input, never replaced by prices.net_price
field_sources.acquiring_amount: product/info/prices acquiring: direct amount per matched product, no inferred percentage or price-ratio projection

guards: No unqualified zero from pending financial_data
Do not relabel forecast as actual charge or final profit
Current tariff not claimed historical actual
No cancelled revenue or COGS
Retain incurred non-COGS costs unless actual reversal; expected tariff/refund scenarios explicitly named
Return-flow composite counted once
Product cost input stays unchanged; denominators explicit per scenario
Missing actual charge triggers authorized tariff fallback rather than unexplained empty result
Do not add historical variable courier/logistics/processing/acquiring charges on top of matched forecast delivery tariffs
Owner rejected tariff inference from sums: use explicit percentage only when returned as percentage, else use explicit API amount
Cancellation type alone must not imply zero reverse logistics or a blanket reverse-tariff charge
Missing official CPO refund rule is unknown, not automatic refund or proven universal nonrefund
Absent Return events in a limited logistic-date window do not establish zero reverse charges
Do not derive final cohort profit from store-day overhead without explicit allocation and scope
No invented cancellation commission reserve
Fresh owner-requested run must contain new source HTTP calls and must not reuse earlier money values
A final result is numeric only if every required component is known or an authorized scoped estimate; otherwise provide calculated subtotal plus explicit unresolved component
Keep per-physical-unit cost250 and label per-ordered-unit allocation separately if used; no silent denominator switch
Ship/assembly state must not establish physical handover
Known cancelled item not physically handed over gets zero forecast for unperformed physical logistics, without deleting real unrelated charges
Do not average zero and a tariff to invent a probability of an unknown physical event
UI report/Excel existence does not establish a public API endpoint
Do not infer real receipt from sentinel dates before order creation
main_cancellation_commission_policy: Official expected net remuneration for noncancelled units; never invent an unobserved cancellation commission charge
conditional_sensitivity: Removed from main result: do not invent cancellation commission liability or a second conditional profit.

event_policy.reverse_logistics: Use matched actual charge/reversal; forecast requires verified scheme and stage applicability. Neither Cancellation nor absent Return proves zero reverse cost.
event_policy.sales_commission: Cancelled revenue and cost of goods excluded; expected sales remuneration only on noncancelled fulfilled units; actual debit/reversal ledger separate.
event_policy.cpo_refund: General cancellation/return policy and time limits not verified in accessible official regulation; do not erase recorded CPO or invent a credit.
event_policy.cpc_refund: Clicks remain a separate service; no automatic sale-outcome reversal. Provider corrections require their own basis.
event_policy.return_processing: Warehouse return processing included in reverse logistics; assess PVZ processing, packaging and storage independently without double count.

not_sufficient: ship endpoint name or POSTING_ALREADY_SHIPPED message
evidence_required: qualified actual handover/acceptance event including pickup/dropoff
historical logistics transition with qualified meaning
owner-confirmed physical fact, explicitly labelled OWNER_CONFIRMED
physical_handover.nulls: Null or sentinel timestamps alone do not prove no handover; no-return records alone do not prove no logistics.
physical_handover.conflicts: Preserve contradictory raw flags; do not infer physical custody from one ambiguous flag. An actual charge conflicting with verified non-handover remains a recorded charge plus discrepancy for investigation, not silently deleted.
physical_handover.case_resolution: Owner confirms selected FBS cancelled item was not physically handed over. Exclude unperformed forward transport, return transport, handover processing and delivery-to-point estimates for that item. Do not erase actual advertising/acquiring or other incurred costs.
physical_handover.flag_backend_trigger: Exact internal cancelled_after_ship trigger NOT_FOUND; do not invent a universal 'after assembly' definition from endpoint naming alone.

partial_nonbuyout.rule: Official example: refusal of one item at receipt leaves original posting Delivered and creates a separate Cancelled posting with return type PartialReturn. Do not classify a cancelled child as an additional whole order cancellation or count both quantities twice; qualify linkage and reason.
partial_nonbuyout.classification: Separate whole-order cancellation before handover, cancellation/nonbuyout after handover, partial refusal at receipt and customer return after receipt. Status cancelled alone does not identify which event occurred.

owner_inputs.if_missing: Report explicit exclusion of user cost/tax and do not claim net profit

required_outputs.logs: Every HTTP request, response summary, UTC start/end, elapsed_ms, pagination completeness

source_join.actual_acquiring: by-day item_fees, type1 from freshly read types dictionary; unique order_number + SKU + quantity, never broad string matching
source_join.posting_accruals: Empty current arrays do not cancel by-day order-level item fees and do not establish zero fees
source_join.general_cardinality_guard: Split, repeated-SKU or ambiguous orders require a qualified allocation; do not assign all order-level cost to one arbitrary posting

forecast.without_cancellations: Counterfactual fulfillment of all original ordered units; all normal unit costs; no reverse-flow event assumed
forecast.with_cancellations: Fulfillment of remaining units; no cancelled revenue or COGS; keep actual non-COGS costs and qualified stage-dependent tariff forecast
forecast.direct_logistics: Use exact actual when available; else owner-authorized arithmetic tariff midpoint for the relevant unit. Unknown event applicability remains a separate scenario, not an invented event probability.
forecast.acquiring_cancelled: Current conservative tariff allocation may be retained as an explicit estimate until refund is evidenced; never call this an incurred debit
forecast.unqualified_extra: Expose X and subtract from calculated subtotal; no final net profit while required components remain unqualified

unit_economics_ui_api.evidence: Official UI article describes table and XLSX; official moderator describes accrual APIs matching store-economy accrual logic. Does not establish a ready unit-economics API endpoint.
unit_economics_ui_api.fallback: Use qualified actual accruals and explicit quantities; if amount missing use a qualified observed per-unit mean, else authorized official/API tariff midpoint; do not invent missing source values or event probabilities.
unit_economics_ui_api.unit_alignment: Check period, revenue definition and denominator before comparing UI sales-with-returns results with an ordered-cohort forecast.

default_scopes.revenue: seller order price/value; buyer discounted payment is a separate metric
default_scopes.overhead: store-period advertising and storage explicitly allocated once; never described as exact posting attribution
default_scopes.percent: row amount / same-scenario seller order value * 100
default_scopes.unit: explicit physical noncancelled-unit denominator; original order denominator separately labelled
